name: Priest of the Beloved
originalText:
### Priest of the Beloved

- **Path Type:** Novice
- **Source:** Beloved of Euphobia
- **Source Page:** 7
- **PDF Page:** 7

```text
Priest of the Beloved
Promises of pleasure, rewards of beauty, peace, and comfort
entice many to prostrate themselves before the mysterious
goddess. Sometimes, she chooses individuals from her
flock who are gifted with rare skills, attractiveness, and
intelligence to become her priests. She grants them the
magic they need to further her interests in the world.
Beloved priests wear no armor or use any item made
from iron or one of its alloys. They decorate their bodies
with flowers, grasses, and other natural materials. If they
must fight, they use clubs, staffs, and spears. Traditions
associated with the cult include Enchantment, Fey, and
Illusion.

Level 1 Priest of the Beloved
Attributes: Increase the scores of two by 1 each.
Characteristics: Health +4, Power +1
Magic: You discover the Enchantment, Fey, or Illusion tradition.
Then, choose two of the following options:
• You discover one of the other two traditions.
• You learn one spell.
Enchanting Recovery: You can use an action to heal damage
equal to your healing rate. Then choose one of the following
effects:
• One creature within short range that’s Charmed by you
heals damage equal to their healing rate.
• Make an Intellect attack roll against the Will of one
creature within short range. On a success, that creature
becomes Charmed for 1 minute. The affliction ends early if
you or your allies harm it.
You then lose access to this talent until you complete a rest. At
level 8, you can use this talent twice before losing access to it.

Level 2 Priest of the Beloved
Characteristics: Health +4
Magic: Choose two of the following options.
• You discover one tradition from the list under Level 1.
• You learn one spell.
Beauteous Prayer: When you make an attack roll or challenge
roll, you can use a triggered action to make the roll with 1
boon. Then, one Charmed creature within short range makes
its next attack roll or challenge roll before the start of your
next turn with 1 boon.

Level 5 Priest of the Beloved
Characteristics: Health +4, Power +1
Magic: You learn one spell.
Emboldened Charm: When a creature you Charmed succeeds
on an attack roll, the creature’s attack deals an extra 1d6
damage.

Level 8 Priest of the Beloved
Characteristics: Health +4
Magic: You learn one spell
Utter Devotion: You can use an action to target one creature
Charmed by you and that is within medium range. The target
becomes Compelled for 1 minute. The affliction ends early if
you become incapacitated. After you use this talent, you lose
access to it until after you complete a rest.
```
